title: Static nonplanar multi-owner zero-headroom localization

measurements.errorRanking: descending absolute RGB reconstruction error, then y, x, channel
measurements.silhouetteDistance: Chebyshev pixel distance from the current pixel to the nearest current-frame pixel that is outside the same owner with alpha greater than 0.999; the image exterior is outside-owner
measurements.vectorIdentity: raw little-endian float32 value, uint32 bit pattern and ratio to 2^-17
measurements.bilinearCoordinates: qx=x+vector.x; qy=y-vector.y; floor coordinates and four float64 weights exactly as the D12.3 consumer
measurements.tapContribution: for each RGB channel, weight times (previous tap minus current center), before the final float32 cast
measurements.localContrast: per-channel maximum minus minimum across the four bilinear source taps
measurements.depthPlanarityProxy: absolute four-neighbor discrete Laplacian of the source Depth pass when all four neighbors share the center owner; otherwise null

requirements: all frozen input file and internal hashes verify before analysis
all adapter and consumer report hashes and bound payload hashes verify
primary and identity-control repeat payloads match byte-for-byte
recomputing the D12.3 bilinear consumer reproduces every formal reconstructed float32 byte
the global interior maximum and all tied coordinates are enumerated
each tied maximum records owner, silhouette distance, Vector bits, weights, tap colors, signed contributions, local contrast and depth-planarity proxy
an independent audit recomputes the global maximum, tied coordinates and reconstruction identity

nonClaims: This post-hoc development diagnostic is not a holdout and cannot promote or revise D12.3.
Exact bilinear decomposition establishes arithmetic accounting, not Blender implementation causality.
The diagnostic does not justify widening the frozen tolerance.
The diagnostic does not cover moving, deforming, transparent, volumetric, hair, particle, motion-blurred or disoccluded content.
No perceptual or cinematic-quality claim is made.
